00062 class RGBAColour
00063 {
00064 public:
00065     RGBAColour(float red = 0.f, float green = 0.f, float blue = 0.f, float alpha = 1.f) throw() 
00066     :   r(red), g(green), b(blue), a(alpha) 
00067     { 
00068         ugen_assert(r >= 0.f && r <= 1.f);
00069         ugen_assert(g >= 0.f && g <= 1.f);
00070         ugen_assert(b >= 0.f && b <= 1.f);
00071         ugen_assert(a >= 0.f && a <= 1.f);
00072     }
00073     
00074     RGBAColour(double red, double green, double blue, double alpha = 1.0) throw() 
00075     :   r((float)red), g((float)green), b((float)blue), a((float)alpha) 
00076     { 
00077         ugen_assert(r >= 0.f && r <= 1.f);
00078         ugen_assert(g >= 0.f && g <= 1.f);
00079         ugen_assert(b >= 0.f && b <= 1.f);
00080         ugen_assert(a >= 0.f && a <= 1.f);      
00081     }
00082     
00083     RGBAColour(int red, int green, int blue, int alpha = 255) throw() 
00084     :   r(red / 255.f), g(green / 255.f), b(blue / 255.f), a(alpha / 255.f) 
00085     {
00086         ugen_assert(r >= 0.f && r <= 1.f);
00087         ugen_assert(g >= 0.f && g <= 1.f);
00088         ugen_assert(b >= 0.f && b <= 1.f);
00089         ugen_assert(a >= 0.f && a <= 1.f);      
00090     }
00091     
00092     RGBAColour(unsigned int rgba) throw()
00093     {
00094         a = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f;  rgba = rgba >> 8;
00095         b = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f;  rgba = rgba >> 8;
00096         g = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f;  rgba = rgba >> 8;
00097         r = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f;
00098         
00099         ugen_assert(r >= 0.f && r <= 1.f);
00100         ugen_assert(g >= 0.f && g <= 1.f);
00101         ugen_assert(b >= 0.f && b <= 1.f);
00102         ugen_assert(a >= 0.f && a <= 1.f);      
00103     }
00104 
00105 #ifdef UGEN_JUCE
00106     RGBAColour(juce::Colour const& juceColour) throw()
00107     :   r(0.f), g(0.f), b(0.f), a(0.f)
00108     {
00109         r = juceColour.getFloatRed();
00110         g = juceColour.getFloatGreen();
00111         b = juceColour.getFloatBlue();
00112         a = juceColour.getFloatAlpha();
00113     }
00114 #endif
00115     
00116 #ifdef UGEN_IPHONE
00117     RGBAColour(CGColorRef colourRef)
00118     :   r(0.f), g(0.f), b(0.f), a(0.f)
00119     {
00120         memcpy(getFloatArray(), CGColorGetComponents(colourRef), 4 * sizeof(float));        
00121     }
00122 //  
00123 //  RGBAColour(UIColor* col)
00124 //  :   r(0.f), g(0.f), b(0.f), a(0.f)
00125 //  {
00126 //      memcpy(getFloatArray(), CGColorGetComponents(colourRef), 4 * sizeof(float));        
00127 //  }   
00128 #endif  
00129     
00130     inline float red() throw()      { return r; }
00131     inline float green() throw()    { return g; }
00132     inline float blue() throw()     { return b; }
00133     inline float alpha() throw()    { return a; }
00134     
00135     inline unsigned long redInt() throw()       { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(r*255.f); return ret; }
00136     inline unsigned long greenInt() throw()     { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(g*255.f); return ret; }
00137     inline unsigned long blueInt() throw()      { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(b*255.f); return ret; }
00138     inline unsigned long alphaInt() throw()     { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(a*255.f); return ret; }
00139     
00140     inline unsigned long get32bitColour() throw() 
00141     { 
00142         unsigned long ret = ((alphaInt() << 24) | (redInt() << 16) | (greenInt() << 8) | blueInt()); 
00143         return ret;
00144     }
00145     
00146     inline float* getFloatArray() throw() { return &r; }
00147     
00148     static const RGBAColour& getNull() throw()
00149     {
00150         static RGBAColour null;
00151         return null;
00152     }
00153     
00154 private:
00155     float r,g,b,a;
00156 };
